prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the uploaded approved adult photo strictly as the facial identity reference. Preserve the same adult person exactly: no change to face structure, apparent age, skin tone, beard, or defining features. Create a cinematic vertical 9:16 ultra-realistic portrait of this adult man standing on a modern city terrace beside a dark reflective glass wall. Softly blur distant blue-gray skyscrapers for clean urban depth. Natural daylight from front-left creates soft shadows and balanced highlights. He faces camera with calm confidence, wearing a fitted deep-red long-sleeve button-down with sleeves rolled below the elbows, black tailored trousers, a black leather belt with rectangular metal buckle, and a silver watch on the left wrist. Upright posture, left hand in trouser pocket, right arm relaxed, eye-level medium shot, full-frame 50mm look, moderate depth of field, and premium cinematic city color.
prompt.negative_prompt: face change, identity alteration, minor, cartoon, CGI, illustration, plastic skin, beauty retouching, over-smoothing, exaggerated muscles, distortion, blur, low resolution, watermark, logo, text, artificial lighting, over-stylized fashion, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, extra fingers, deformed
